description: React component for the 'Read Aloud' settings tab, managing speech synthesis voices, volume, and playback controls.

methods.name: getAvailableVoices
methods.description: Retrieves available speech synthesis voices from the browser.

methods.name: handleVoiceChange
methods.description: Handles change in selected voice, updating user settings.

methods.name: getLanguageRegion
methods.description: Returns a display name for a language code, including region if available.

methods.name: handleVoiceVolCommitChange
methods.description: Updates user settings with new voice volume after slider change.

methods.name: handleMuteClick
methods.description: Toggles mute/unmute for voice volume, saving previous volume.

methods.name: getFlagUnicodes
methods.description: Converts country code to regional indicator symbols for flag emojis.
